T: Room service. Charge it to Dad.
D: Kevin boards the wrong plane and ends up alone at a fancy New York hotel with Dad's credit card.
P: Order room service when Kevin gets his own suite.
S: nuts and chocolate, the overpriced stuff
Roast mixed nuts with butter, brown sugar and rosemary, mix with chocolate-coated almonds and pretzels.
Prawns poached 2 minutes and iced, on shredded iceberg with Marie Rose sauce, a dusting of paprika and lemon wedges.
charged straight to Dad's credit card
Triple-decker toast with sliced chicken, bacon, lettuce, tomato and mayo, cut into quarters and pinned with toothpicks, served under a silver cloche if you have one.
M: a whole one, delivered to the car, just like Kevin
Cold-fermented dough stretched thin, crushed tomato with salt and oregano, low-moisture mozzarella, on a hot steel at max heat for 7 minutes, cut into eight.
Macaroni in a Gruyère and cheddar béchamel, folded through with butter-poached lobster, buttered crumbs on top, baked.

dishes.make_ahead: Up to 1 week in an airtight jar

steps.text: Melt the butter with the brown sugar and rosemary, then toss through the nuts.
Spread on a tray and roast at 170C, stirring once.
Cool completely, then mix with the chocolate almonds and pretzels.
Poach the chicken breasts in simmering water until cooked through, then slice.
Toast the bread and spread with mayonnaise. Slice the tomatoes and shred the lettuce.
Build 4 triple-deckers with chicken, bacon, lettuce and tomato. Cut into quarters and pin each with a toothpick.

dishes.make_ahead: Assemble up to 1 day ahead, bake to serve

steps.text: Remove the lobster meat from the shells. Boil the macaroni and drain well.
Gently poach the lobster meat in some of the butter, then chop.
Melt more butter, stir in the flour, then whisk in the warm milk and simmer. Stir in the Gruyere and cheddar.
Fold through the macaroni and lobster and tip into a baking dish.
Top with the panko mixed with melted butter and bake at 200C until golden.

dishes.make_ahead: Fudge up to 3 days ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Melt the chocolate with some of the cream for the hot fudge.
Pile the ice cream into four tall glasses, pour over the fudge, then add cream, nuts, sprinkles and a cherry on each.
Warm the apple juice with some of the cinnamon sticks, the cloves, peel and sugar over low heat without boiling.
Strain into 4 mugs and serve steaming with a fresh cinnamon stick in each.

edition.cue: Order room service when Kevin gets his own suite.

s.note: Buttery rosemary nuts with chocolate almonds and pretzels.
s.how: Melt 30g butter with 2 tbsp brown sugar and 1 tbsp chopped rosemary. Toss through 300g mixed nuts, spread on a tray and roast at 170C for 12 minutes, stirring once. Cool, then mix with 150g chocolate almonds and 100g pretzels.

s.note: Room service triple-decker with chicken, bacon, lettuce and tomato.
s.how: Poach 2 chicken breasts (400g) for 12 minutes and slice. Grill 8 rashers bacon until crisp. Toast 12 slices white bread and spread with mayonnaise. Build 4 triple-deckers with chicken, bacon, iceberg and sliced tomato, cut into quarters and pin each with a toothpick.

m.note: Macaroni in Gruyère cheese sauce with butter-poached lobster and crumbs.
m.how: Gently poach the meat of 2 lobster tails in 40g butter for 4 minutes and chop. Melt 40g butter, stir in 40g flour, then whisk in 600ml warm milk and simmer 5 minutes. Stir in 120g grated Gruyère and 100g cheddar. Fold through 400g cooked macaroni and the lobster, tip into a dish, top with 40g panko mixed with 20g melted butter and bake at 200C for 20 minutes.

w.note: Towering sundae with hot fudge, cream, nuts, sprinkles and a cherry.
w.how: Melt 100g dark chocolate with 100ml thickened cream for hot fudge. Whip another 200ml cream. Pile 8 scoops vanilla ice cream into four tall glasses, pour over the fudge, add the cream, 40g chopped nuts, sprinkles and a maraschino cherry on each.

d.note: Warm spiced apple juice with cinnamon, cloves and orange.
d.how: Warm 1L cloudy apple juice with 2 cinnamon sticks, 6 cloves, 3 strips orange peel and 1 tbsp brown sugar over low heat for 15 minutes without boiling. Strain into 4 mugs and serve steaming with a cinnamon stick in each.
